title: Claim Verifiability(TM)
purpose: allow neutral review using evidence alone
definition: A claim is verifiable when a third party can review the documentation and reach the same conclusions without being present at the inspection or relying on inspector authority.
principle: Evidence must carry the authority, not the individual.

conditions.name: Objectivity
conditions.description: Evidence shows observable conditions; conclusions are traceable to documented facts; opinions are separated from observations.

conditions.name: Completeness
conditions.description: The inspection documents the full roof system context; missing viewpoints or incomplete coverage weaken verification.

conditions.name: Traceability
conditions.description: Each conclusion maps to specific evidence so a reviewer can identify where, what, and why.

conditions.name: Continuity
conditions.description: Photos, notes, diagrams, and sequencing align as a coherent narrative without contradiction.

minimum_evidence_package: Property context photos: front, back, and sides
Consistent photo framing and scale reference where applicable

academy_levels.title: The Maintenance Manual
academy_levels.desc: Distinguish normal wear from storm damage. Learn to spot the real problems.
academy_levels.a: Maintenance is gradual aging. Storm damage is sudden and event-driven. Dates matter.

academy_levels.title: Roof Ancestry
academy_levels.desc: Know your roof material history and why matching can be difficult in repairs.
academy_levels.a: Old roofs can be hard to repair because material compatibility and matching affect the scope.

academy_levels.title: Storm Spotter
academy_levels.desc: Identify hail and wind indicators by looking for patterns that matter.
academy_levels.a: Collateral indicators. If gutters, vents, or soft metals show impact patterns, roof damage can be evaluated in context.

academy_levels.title: The Roadmap
academy_levels.desc: Master the claim timeline: inspection, decision, estimate, supplement.
academy_levels.a: Keep a timeline. Save every email, photo, receipt, and conversation note in one place.

academy_levels.title: Camera Protocols
academy_levels.desc: Take photos that tell a story: context first, zoom second.
academy_levels.a: Overview of property, roof slope, damage area, then close-up detail.

academy_levels.title: Evidence Standard
academy_levels.desc: Make a claim verifiable. Facts beat opinions every time.
academy_levels.a: Verifiable means another reviewer can see the same evidence and reach the same conclusion without guessing.

academy_levels.title: The Organizer
academy_levels.desc: Build a claim ledger and never lose track of a conversation again.
academy_levels.a: A log of who you talked to, when, what was said, and what evidence supports the next step.

academy_levels.title: Meeting the Adjuster
academy_levels.desc: Keep it calm and factual. Handle site meetings as verification events.
academy_levels.a: Agree on observable facts and documented findings. Do not turn the meeting into a coverage argument.

academy_levels.title: Stall Breaker
academy_levels.desc: Prevent delays by identifying which missing information causes the claim to freeze.
academy_levels.q: How do you stop a stall?
academy_levels.a: Ask what specific information is needed to move forward, then provide exactly that evidence.

academy_levels.title: Decoder Ring
academy_levels.desc: Understand denial letters and what phrases like wear and tear imply.
academy_levels.q: How do you read a denial?
academy_levels.a: Look for the stated reason. Is it a policy issue or an evidence gap? Fix the evidence gap first.

academy_levels.title: Engineer Speak
academy_levels.desc: Learn functional vs. cosmetic language and how professionals classify damage.
academy_levels.a: Damage that affects water shedding, seal integrity, material behavior, or system performance.

academy_levels.title: Green Protocols
academy_levels.desc: Understand ventilation, longevity, and roof system performance.
academy_levels.a: Not just shingles. It includes ventilation, insulation, intake, exhaust, flashing, underlayment, and accessories working together.

academy_levels.title: The Capstone
academy_levels.desc: Final exam: vet advice and make confident decisions using evidence.
academy_levels.a: Trust but verify. Every conclusion should be backed by photos, measurements, notes, and standards.
